d:
The Jazz defeated the Clippers, 132-107 tonight in LA. Brice Sensabaugh contributed a team-high 40 points to go with 11 rebounds 8 three pointers and 5 assists, with Keyonte George of the Jazz adding an additional 30 points (10-17 FG, 4-8 3P) in the game. Brook Lopez finished with a team-high 23 points along with 6 rebounds for the Clippers in the losing effort. The Jazz improve their record to 2-13 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 4-9 for the season.
